sensorCluster.title: Sensor cluster
sensorCluster.subtitle: Confirm the readings that anchor this verification.

bullets.pickSensors: Pick at least 2 sensors within the affected ward (3+ preferred).
bullets.last24h: Last 24 h of readings auto-load — look for the breach window.
bullets.crossCheck: Cross-check the cluster against the published calibration log.

anjaliCorroboration.title: Anjali corroboration
anjaliCorroboration.subtitle: Attach the citizen report to the same hash envelope.

bullets.waitAck: Wait for Anjali (or her proxy) to acknowledge the broadcast.
bullets.citizenSig: Citizen signature links to the same block — chain-verify will walk it.
bullets.escalate: If 6 h passes with no ack, escalate to PHA (this step turns amber).

councillorNotify.title: Councillor notify
councillorNotify.subtitle: Broadcast to the ward councillor for political sign-off.

bullets.sms: One-tap SMS to the assigned councillor — no editing.
bullets.publicKey: Councillor’s public key signs the same envelope, completing the chain.
bullets.allSigners: All 4 signers are pinned in the block once this step is sealed.
